name: Suresh Kumar
pain_point: Reliance on manual distribution for timely access to rations; fear of exclusion due to lack of smartphone or digital literacy.
quote: How will I get my food if I can't use this app? I don't have a phone, and I can't read well.

name: Aisha Begum
pain_point: Irregular income makes affording a smartphone and data plan difficult. Worried about missing rations if unable to link ID.
quote: My earnings are not fixed. Buying a smartphone seems like a luxury, but now it's a necessity for my family's food.

name: Ramesh Reddy
occupation: Small Grocery Shop Owner (reliant on PDS)
pain_point: Concerned about potential disruption to his supplementary income from assisting PDS beneficiaries and his own ration needs if the system is not smooth.
quote: I help many people here with their rations. If this digital system fails, it will affect many, including me.

name: Priya Sharma
pain_point: Limited digital literacy and access to a smartphone for her elderly mother, who is the primary beneficiary. Worried about her mother's ability to navigate the app.
quote: My mother is old and doesn't understand technology. I'll have to manage this for her, but what if I'm not around?

name: Vikram Singh
pain_point: Occasional access to reliable internet and a smartphone. Concerned about data costs and the hassle of linking the ID.
quote: I have a basic phone, but internet is not always reliable. I hope this process is quick and doesn't cost me much.

name: Lakshmi Devi
pain_point: Uses a shared family smartphone with limited availability. Worried about the app crashing or not working when she needs to collect rations.
quote: We all share one phone. It's hard to find time to do this, and I'm scared the app won't work when I need it.

name: Arjun Patel
pain_point: Comfortable with technology but concerned about potential data privacy issues with linking biometric IDs to a welfare app.
quote: I can easily use the app, but I'm cautious about how my personal data will be used and secured.

name: Sunita Rao
pain_point: Owns a smartphone but faces intermittent network connectivity in her area, potentially hindering the linking process.
quote: My internet connection is very weak here. I hope the app works without constant disconnections.

name: Mohan Das
pain_point: While digitally capable, concerned about the reliability of the app and potential technical glitches affecting his pension-linked ration access.
quote: I am comfortable with technology, but I've seen government systems fail. I hope this is different.

name: Anjali Singh
pain_point: Finds the app interface potentially cumbersome for routine tasks and questions the necessity of biometric linking for a digital process.
quote: It's a bit over the top with biometrics for just linking. The app could be more user-friendly.

name: Rahul Verma
pain_point: Believes the policy is a good step towards transparency but is concerned about the digital divide and the exclusion of the truly unbanked/unconnected.
quote: Great initiative for transparency, but we need to ensure no one is left behind due to lack of access or skills.

name: Deepika Agarwal
pain_point: Sees the policy as efficient but questions the blanket approach, suggesting more targeted digital literacy programs alongside the mandate.
quote: The app is fine for people like me, but what about the elderly or those who can't afford smartphones? More support is needed.

name: Ajay Kumar
pain_point: While comfortable with the app, worries about potential system downtime or security breaches affecting the accessibility of rations.
quote: I can manage the app easily, but I hope the system is robust and secure. We rely on this for essentials.

name: Fatima Khan
pain_point: Doesn't own a smartphone and relies on her neighbor to help with such tasks. Fearful of becoming a burden or missing out.
quote: I don't have a phone of my own. I'm afraid if my neighbor isn't available, I won't get my rations.

name: Karthik Rao
pain_point: Limited technical knowledge and infrequent access to a smartphone. Concerned about the complexity of the app and the biometric linking.
quote: Farming is my life. Understanding these apps and linking my biometrics is too complicated for me.

name: Geeta Devi
pain_point: Relies on a basic feature phone and has no digital literacy. Dependent on family members to manage this, creating anxiety.
quote: I have no idea how to use a smartphone or this app. My children help me, but they are busy.

name: Rajesh Gupta
pain_point: Questions the necessity of the biometric linkage and the associated costs and infrastructure for a potentially small reduction in leakage.
quote: Is this level of security and technology really needed for ration distribution? Seems like overkill.

name: Shanti Bai
pain_point: Has no access to a smartphone or internet. Relies on neighbours, but fears being unable to access rations if they are unavailable or unwilling to help.
quote: I'm too old for these new things. I depend on others, and I'm scared they will get tired of helping me.

name: Sanjay Kumar
pain_point: Uses a smartphone for work but finds its battery life and data limits challenging. Worried about app performance issues.
quote: My phone is always busy with work. I hope the app doesn't drain my battery or use too much data.

name: Pooja S.
pain_point: Concerned about the security of biometric data and potential for identity theft through the app.
quote: Biometric data is sensitive. I hope the app has strong security measures to protect it.
